sanskrit: uttamo asy oṣadhīnām anaḍvān jagatām iva vyāghraḥ śvapadām iva | yam aicchāmāvadāma taṃ pratispāśanam abruvan ||
english: Thou art the foremost of plants, as a bull-ox among cattle, as a tiger among beasts of prey. The one we sought and named — of him they declared thee a counter-noose.

sanskrit: sa id vyāghro bhavaty atho siṃho atho vṛṣā sarvā diśo vi rājati yo bibhartīmaṃ maṇim ||
english: He indeed becomes a tiger, and a lion, and a bull; he radiates in all directions — the one who wears this amulet.

sanskrit: nainaṃ ghnanty apsaraso na gandharvā na martyāḥ | sarvā diśo vi rājāti yo bibhartīmaṃ maṇim ||
english: The Apsarases do not smite him, nor the Gandharvas, nor mortals — he radiates in all directions, the one who wears this amulet.

sanskrit: kaśyapas tvām asṛjata kaśyapas tvāṃ samairayat | abibhas tvendro mānuṣe bibhrat saṃśreṣiṇe 'jayat ||
english: Kaśyapa created thee; Kaśyapa set thee in motion. Indra, fearless himself, wore thee among men; bearing thee, he conquered for the sake of adhesion.

sanskrit: maṇiṃ sapatnajambhanaṃ varma devā abadhnata | yas tvā kṛtyābhir yas tvā dīkṣābhir yas tvā yajñair jighāṃsati | pratyak tvam indra taṃ jahi vajreṇa śataparvaṇā ||
english: The gods bound on this amulet as armour — the destroyer of rivals. Whoever seeks to slay thee with sorceries, whoever with consecrations, whoever with sacrifices — turn back upon him, O Indra; smite him with the hundred-jointed thunderbolt.

sanskrit: ayam id vai pratīvartaḥ sahasvān sañjayo maṇiḥ | prajāṃ dhanaṃ ca rakṣatu paripāṇaḥ sumaṅgalaḥ ||
english: This indeed is the repelling amulet, mighty and victorious. Auspicious and protective, may it guard progeny and wealth.

sanskrit: asapatnaṃ no adharād asapatnaṃ na uttarāt | indrāsapatnaṃ naḥ paścāj jyotiḥ śūra puras kṛdhi ||
english: Free us from rivals below, free us from rivals above. O heroic Indra, place before us a rival-free light from the rear.

sanskrit: aindrāgnaṃ varma bahulaṃ yad ugraṃ viśve devā nāti vidhyanti sarve | tat te tanvaṃ trāyatāṃ sarvato bṛhad āyuṣmān jaradaṣṭir yathāsat ||
english: The broad armour belonging to Indra and Agni, that fierce one which all the gods together do not pierce — may that great armour protect thy body from every side, so that thou mayest live long and reach old age.

sanskrit: ā tvārukṣad devamaṇir mahyā ariṣṭatātaye | imaṃ methim abhisaṃviśadhvaṃ tanūpānaṃ trivarūtham ojase ||
english: The divine amulet has mounted thee for my inviolability. Enter into this stake-post — the triple-shielded guardian of the body — for strength.

sanskrit: asminn indro ni dadhātu nṛmṇam imaṃ devāso abhisaṃviśadhvam | dīrghāyutvāya śataśāradāya- -āyuṣmān jaradaṣṭir yathāsat ||
english: May Indra lodge manly vigour in this; O gods, enter into it. For long life, for a hundred autumns — may he live long and reach old age.

sanskrit: indro badhnātu te maṇiṃ jigīvām̐ aparājitaḥ somapā abhayaṅkaro vṛṣā | sa tvā rakṣatu sarvadā divā naktaṃ ca viśvataḥ ||
english: Indra — the victorious, the unvanquished, the Soma-drinker, the terror-slayer, the bull — has bound this amulet for thee. May he protect thee always, by day and by night, from every side.

sanskrit: indro manthatu manthitā śakraḥ śūraḥ purandaraḥ | yathā hanāma senām amitrāṇāṃ sahasraśaḥ ||
english: May Indra, the churner, churn — Śakra the heroic, the smasher of citadels — so that we may slay the army of enemies by thousands.

sanskrit: pūtirajjur upadhmānī pūtiṃ senāṃ kṛṇotv amūm | agniṃ dhūmaṃ parādṛśya hṛtsv ā dadhatāṃ bhayam ||
english: May the stinking cord, the blower, make yonder army fetid. Having shown them fire and smoke, may they place dread in their hearts.

sanskrit: paruṣān amūn paruṣāhvaḥ kṛṇotu hanty enān vadhako vadhaiḥ | kṣipraṃ śara iva bhajyantāṃ bṛhajjālena saṃjitāḥ ||
english: May he who is called 'the Rough' render those ones rough; the slayer strikes them down with blows. May they shatter quickly like arrows, overpowered by the great net.

sanskrit: amūn aśvattha ni śṛṇīhi khādāmūn khadirājiram | tājadbhaṅga iva bhajyantāṃ bṛhajjālena saṃjitāḥ ||
english: O Aśvattha, crush those yonder; O swift-striding Khadira, gnaw them. May they break apart like a fragment of tājad-wood, overpowered by the great net.

sanskrit: antarikṣaṃ jālam āsīj jāladaṇḍā diśo mahīḥ | tenābhidāya senām indro dasyūn apāvapat ||
english: The mid-air was a net; the great earth and the directions were its net-poles. With it, having encompassed the army, Indra swept away the Dasyus.

sanskrit: bṛhat te jālaṃ bṛhata indra śūra sahasrārghasya śatavīryasya | tenā ny ubja maghavann amitrān śaśvatībhyaḥ samābhyaḥ ||
english: Great is thy net, O great heroic Indra, worth a thousand, of a hundredfold power. With it, O Maghavan, press down the enemies for all future seasons.

sanskrit: bṛhat te jālaṃ bṛhataś śakrasya vājinīvataḥ | tenā śataṃ sahasram ayutaṃ jaghāna- -indro dasyūnām abhidhāya senām ||
english: Great is thy net, of great Śakra, lord of vigor. With it Indra, having enveloped the army, slew hundreds, thousands, ten-thousands of Dasyus.

sanskrit: ayaṃ loko jālam āsīc chakrasya mahato mahān | tenāham indrajālena tamasāmūn abhi dadhāmi sarvān ||
english: This great world was the net of the great Śakra. With that Indra's net, together with darkness, I encompass all those yonder.

sanskrit: sedir ugrāvartir ārtiś cānapavācanā | śramas tandrīś ca mohaś ca tair amūn abhi dadhāmi sarvān ||
english: Languor, fierce tumult, torment, and irreversibility — exhaustion, lassitude, and bewilderment — with these I encompass all those yonder.

sanskrit: mṛtyave amūn pra yacchāmi mṛtyupāśair amī sitāḥ | mṛtyor ye aghalā dūtās tebhya enān prati nayāmi baddhvā ||
english: I deliver those yonder over to Death; they are bound by Death's snares. To the grievous messengers of Death I conduct them, having bound them.

sanskrit: mṛtyudūtā amūn nayata yamadūtā apombhata | paraḥ sahasrā hanyantāṃ tṛṇeḍhv enān matyaṃ bhavasya ||
english: O messengers of Death, lead those yonder away; O messengers of Yama, press them out. May they be slain by the thousands afar; despise them — these are the mindless ones of Bhava.

sanskrit: sādhyā ekaṃ jāladaṇḍam udyatya yanty ojasā | rudrā dvitīyaṃ vasavas tṛtīyam ādityair eka udyataḥ ||
english: The Sādhyas advance with strength, raising one net-pole. The Rudras raise the second; the Vasus the third; one is raised by the Ādityas.

sanskrit: viśve devā upariṣṭād ubjanto yantv ojasā | madhyena ghnanto yantu senām aṅgiraso vadhaiḥ ||
english: May all the gods advance from above, pressing down with strength. May the Aṅgirases advance striking the army with their weapons through the middle.

sanskrit: vanaspatīn vānaspatyān oṣadhīr uta vīrudhaḥ | dvipāc catuṣpād iṣṇāmi yathā senām amūṃ hanat ||
english: Trees, tree-born things, medicinal plants, and creeping herbs — two-footed and four-footed things — I urge on so that they may smite yonder army.

sanskrit: gandharvāpsaraso devān sarpān puṇyajanān pitṝn | dṛṣṭān adṛṣṭān iṣṇāmi yathā senām amūṃ hanat ||
english: Gandharvas and Apsarases, gods, serpents, the blessed folk, the Fathers — seen and unseen — I urge on so that they may smite yonder army.

sanskrit: mṛtyupāśā ime yuktā yān ākramya na mucyase | amuṣyā hantu senāyā idaṃ kūṭaṃ sahasraśaḥ ||
english: These snares of Death are set — those into which, once entering, thou art not released. May this bludgeon smite yonder army by thousands.

sanskrit: gharmaḥ samiddho agninā- -ayaṃ homaḥ sahasrahā | bhavaś ca pṛśnibāhuḥ śarva senām amūṃ hatam ||
english: The gharma-cauldron is kindled with fire — this oblation is a thousand-slayer. O Bhava of the speckled arms, and Śarva, smite yonder army.

sanskrit: mṛtyor oṣam ā padyantāṃ kṣudhaṃ sediṃ vadhaṃ bhayam | indraś cākṣujālābhyāṃ śarva senām amūṃ hatam ||
english: May they fall into the scorching heat of Death, into hunger, languor, slaughter, and fear. And Indra with his eye-nets, and Śarva — smite yonder army.

sanskrit: parājitāḥ pra trasatāmitrā jitā dhāvata brahmaṇā | bṛhaspatipraṇuttānāṃ māmīṣāṃ moci kaś cana ||
english: Vanquished, may the enemies flee in terror; conquered by the brahman, may they run. Of those driven forth by Bṛhaspati, may not one of these be released.

sanskrit: ava padyantām eṣām āyudhāni mā śakan pratidhām iṣum | athaiṣāṃ bahu bibhyatām iṣavo ghnantu marmaṇi ||
english: May their weapons fall away; may they not be able to set an arrow to the string. Then, as they tremble with great fear, may arrows strike their vital points.

sanskrit: sam enān krośatāṃ dyāvāpṛthivī ubhe sam antarikṣaṃ saha devatābhiḥ | mā jñātāraṃ mā pratiṣṭhāṃ vidanta mitho 'pighnānā upa yantu mṛtyum ||
english: May both Heaven and Earth cry out together against them; may the mid-air cry out together with the deities. May they find no kinsman, no support; striking one another down, may they go unto death.
